sources.title: Y-T-G/shopee-sentiment-analysis - GitHub
sources.snippet: Sentiment Analysis on Shopee Reviews This project utilizes Blurr library's huggingface transformers integration for the FastAI deep learning framework to fine-tune the BERT language model for sentiment analysis using the Shopee Sentiment Analysis dataset from Kaggle.

sources.title: gracechia/Sentiment-Analysis-for-Shopee - GitHub
sources.snippet: The data science team web scraped 4,461 unique user reviews on Shopee's Google Play. Classical machine learning and deep learning NLP approaches were explored when building a sentiment classification model for Shopee reviews. sources.title: Sentiment Analysis of Shopee Reviews
sources.snippet: The document outlines a sentiment analysis project for Shopee, aiming to classify user reviews and identify customer pain points using natural language processing. A voting classifier was selected for its high accuracy and recall, achieving 0.892 accuracy on the test set. Key recommendations include improving payment stability, addressing fraudulent sellers, and optimizing app performance ...
